# Project B Knowledge Rules

## Project Scope
Serve compliance reviewers and keep project B isolated from project A.

## Evidence Hierarchy
Factual claims require eligible primary evidence and explicit source revisions.

## Allowed Page Kinds
Use only the page kinds declared in frontmatter.

## Frontmatter Schema
Every page declares title, kind, status, and citations.

## Citation Convention
Use exact project B source IDs for every factual claim.

## Contradiction Policy
Keep unresolved claims side by side pending reviewer decision.

## SOP Requirements
Name controls, owners, evidence, exceptions, and approvals.

## Content Voice
Use concise compliance-review language.

## Maintenance Workflow
All Wiki and method publication requires administrator review.
